build_FrameData: build a FrameData object from frame and sequence annotations using FrameDataBuilder with crop and resize options
build_FrameDataBuilder: build a FrameDataBuilder with custom dataset root, image dimensions, and blob loading flags to construct FrameData
crop_FrameData_by_bbox: crop a FrameData object in-place by its metadata bounding box with configurable expansion context
resize_FrameData: resize a FrameData object in-place to target height and width dimensions preserving aspect ratio
collate_FrameData_batch: collate a list of FrameData objects into a batched representation for deep network processing
